digest.component_or_area: CI gate steps in GitHub Actions workflows
propositions: Gate steps that run repo scripts in _build-and-test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml fail with exit code 2 when scripts are absent from the checked-out tree, causing false Verified -1 votes on changes predating script addition

Gerrit's Verified lane uses the workflow definition from the target branch but checks out the change's tree, causing gate steps added to main to run against open changes whose base predates the script
Eleven enumerated gate steps across two workflows lacked if-present guards: 9 in _build-and-test.yml and 2 in gerrit-verify.yaml golden-path job
Gate steps must skip with a log line when their script is absent, per the ee2a convention, to distinguish tree skew from real gate violations
A structural guard must prevent new instances by failing on any Gerrit-lane step that runs a repo script without an if-present guard
